tools.name: Signlz
tools.description: Signlz lets you go from a single prompt to a complete PRD in minutes, automatically expanding your idea into structured requirements and ready-to-assign tasks.
bullets: One-prompt PRD creation with auto-generated technical specs and user stories
Instant export of PRD + tasks to Jira, Linear, or any task manager

tools.name: Brilworks PRD Generator
tools.description: Enter a brief vision or feature idea and BrilWorks instantly produces a full-length, investor-ready PRD complete with market analysis and user stories.
bullets: AI suggests missing features and competitive differentiators while you type
Generates sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria in under 2 minutes

tools.name: GetBash PRD Generarot
tools.description: Turn any raw material—competitor pages, meeting notes, or even a voice memo—into a polished PRD in seconds; no blank-page syndrome.
bullets: Scrapes competitor sites to reverse-engineer their requirements into your PRD
Accepts audio recordings and auto-transcribes them into structured product specs

tools.name: Write My PRD
tools.description: Chat-style interface that converts a few bullet points about your feature into a comprehensive PRD with scope, user stories, and success metrics.
bullets: GPT-powered prompts pre-tuned for PRD best-practices—no prompt engineering needed
Iterate live: paste existing notes and watch the AI merge them into a clean spec instantly

tools.name: ChatPRD
tools.description: Your on-demand CPO: give ChatPRD a goal or pain point and it returns a complete, board-level PRD plus coaching tips in about 30 minutes.
bullets: Built-in CPO simulator reviews your draft and flags gaps or weak assumptions
Library of product-specific templates (API, mobile, AI features) ready to populate

tools.name: Aigents
tools.description: Pick the “PRD Generator” agent, feed it your idea or market insight, and receive a structured PRD plus supporting research in one click—no setup required.
bullets: Dedicated AI agent solely focused on PRD creation—finetuned on 100k+ PM examples
100 % web-based; start generating your PRD immediately without sign-up friction

tools.name: Wisary
tools.description: Inside Confluence, Wisary guides you through a smart Q&A to auto-build a gap-free PRD that instantly converts into Jira user stories and test cases.
bullets: AI asks clarifying questions so your PRD never misses edge cases or stakeholders
One-click sync turns the finished PRD into linked user stories and QA test plans

tools.name: ProdPad CoPilot
tools.description: Tell CoPilot your product problem and it drafts a PRD tied directly to your OKRs, roadmap, and backlog—ensuring every requirement drives measurable outcomes.
bullets: AI links each PRD section to existing roadmap items and strategic goals automatically
Instantly spots duplicate or conflicting ideas across your backlog while writing the PRD
